steps.what: Examine the fire or explosion scene and decide which damage and evidence, context and viewpoints need photographic documentation.
Photograph damage and evidence related to the causes of fires or explosions, checking framing and image clarity at the scene without altering the original evidence.
outputs: Original camera images and native metadata

steps.what: Write the actual image captions and scene identifiers in the evidence catalogue draft {OTHER}, linking them to the original image files.
outputs: Draft image catalogue with factual captions

steps.what: Check the completed image set and catalogue against the scene coverage, original files and case identity before evidential filing.
Commit the checked original images and catalogue to the case evidence repository {OTHER}.

tasks.design: No new saving demonstrated. Retain scene judgment, photographic capture and factual captions. Existing camera metadata and repository filing are already software work; do not count their runtime as a new human saving or generate evidence images.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coverage and context depend on direct scene observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing cameras and evidence repositories already support capture and native metadata.
tasks.still_hard: Knowing what must be photographed before the scene changes.
tasks.altitude: Scene investigation stays with the investigator.

evidence.claim: Original evidence photography and factual scene captions require actual capture and observation; existing metadata does not establish the evidence's meaning.

assumptions: Illustrative task allocation, not a measured baseline. Actual caption writing and filing have been split before concluding zero; no manual metadata re-entry is invented.
s2 creates actual original files. The filing action in s5 is separate from capture. No onward evidence disclosure or external upload is assumed.
s4 is the ordinary completed-package check and supplies the requested exact-version commit gate. No extra self-approval work; edits invalidate the check. Filing remains fully retained.
research_questions: Is there demonstrated repeated administrative entry beyond existing camera metadata?

already_counted.description: All scene decisions, photography, caption writing, final checks and filing remain unchanged.

approvals.approved_version: Exact original images and catalogue checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Every separately examined step remains at 100%; no new reducible work established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Examine the scene and collect physical evidence

steps.what: Examine fire sites and decide which debris or residues are relevant evidence for determining the cause of a fire.
Collect the selected physical evidence and preserve its identity and condition under the existing evidence-handling procedure.
Write the actual collection location, identifiers, observed condition and custody information in the evidence record draft {OTHER}.
outputs: Populated evidence collection record in the case system

steps.what: Reconcile the completed collection record to the actual collected items, their identifiers and observed custody before filing.
Commit the checked collection and custody record to the case evidence system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Retain the actual scene examination, collection and custody recording. No zero-saving shortcut hides the record: it is a separate 19% writing step, checked and filed separately. No demonstrated redundant transcription is available to remove.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence meaning and preservation depend on physical context.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability demonstrated for these actual collection steps.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting representative evidence and avoiding loss of context.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable scene decisions and accurate custody observations.

evidence.claim: Physical evidence collection and its observed custody history cannot be inferred from a generated record.

assumptions: E1 allocation for a collection episode through its actual case record; not a measured baseline. Camera photography is a separate task and receives no duplicate saving here.
s2 and s3 alternate by item; records describe observed events, not planned or calendar-inferred collection. No clean evidence feed or invented duplicate entry is assumed.

The path ends with the collected evidence held under existing scene custody. Any later transfer to a laboratory requires its own real transfer, acknowledgment and custody update; that later task has no claimed saving here.
s4 is ordinary final reconciliation, gating the exact record commit without added approval labour. Save effort is fully retained.
research_questions: Is any current record field demonstrably copied twice rather than captured once?

already_counted.description: Scene examination, physical collection, actual collection record, reconciliation and filing remain counted.

incremental.description: No process or system change proposed.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual collection record reconciled in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All physical, writing, checking and filing steps remain at 100%. No reducible repeated entry is evidenced.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find the approved age-appropriate fire safety teaching material for the actual children's group in the education library {DOCS}.
Adapt the session outline to the group using the selected approved pages {DOCS} and check its accuracy and suitability.
Instruct children about the dangers of fire, respond to their questions and check their understanding in the actual session.
Write and check the actual delivered-session entry in the existing outreach activity log {OTHER}.
Save the checked delivered-session entry in the outreach activity log {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure age and setting filters in the approved material library. Keep adaptation and all child-facing instruction human. No chatbot, generated safety advice or automatic learning-completion claim is needed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Approved materials are repeatedly found by browsing mixed-age folders.
tasks.enabler_now: Native tags and saved library filters.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to children's understanding and concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Teaching safely in the actual room.
tasks.altitude: Human teaching remains the main work.

evidence.claim: Tagged approved teaching collections can reduce repeated material retrieval while live teaching remains human.

assumptions: Illustrative E1 allocation where manual material browsing exists. If the material is already readily available, saving is zero.

The activity log is an existing brief outreach record, not an invented detailed child assessment. Its actual writing and save are separate and fully retained. No individual child data is required for this design.

s4 checks actual delivery after the session, not the calendar end. It supplies the requested exact-version save gate with no added approval labour. The personal session dialogue is not an automated outbound transaction.
research_questions: Do age filters reliably return current approved material and shorten real preparation?

already_counted.description: Source inspection, full adaptation, teaching, actual activity entry and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain age and setting tags after material updates.

approvals.approved_version: Exact delivered-session entry checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 30% lookup reduction = 3 gross points less 0.5 upkeep; no teaching or record saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect hazardous-material properties and issue permits

steps.what: Inspect properties that store, handle and use hazardous materials, reading the actual application and examining conditions against the applicable laws, codes and regulations.
outputs: Observed property conditions and supporting evidence

steps.what: Write the actual inspection findings and unresolved deficiencies into the permit case draft {OTHER}.
outputs: Populated inspection findings with evidence references

steps.what: Decide whether the facility is in compliance and whether the inspector has authority to issue the proposed hazardous materials permit.
outputs: Human compliance determination and permitted scope or hold decision

steps.what: Prepare the actual permit document in the permit system {OTHER} from existing application fields and the inspector's selected scope and conditions.
Check the completed permit, conditions, property identity and addressee against the actual compliance determination and issuance authority.
outputs: Checked exact permit version and recipient, or hold

steps.what: Save the checked permit package to the permit case record {OTHER}.
inputs: Exact permit package checked in s5
outputs: Saved permit package ready for authorised issuance

steps.what: Issue the exact checked hazardous materials permit to the verified facility recipient through the permit system {OTHER}.
inputs: Recipient and authority checked in s5
outputs: Issued permit and native issue audit trail

tasks.design: Configure the existing permit system's document merge from application fields and human-selected conditions. Keep inspection, actual findings entry, compliance judgment and final permit check. Issuance is its own action after the final document exists.
tasks.previous_blocker: Application identifiers and authorised conditions are manually copied into permit documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Native permit templates can reuse existing case fields.
tasks.still_hard: Whether actual conditions meet applicable criteria.
tasks.human_edge: Accountable determination and issuance within delegated authority.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated document entry for existing compliant permits.

tasks.altitude: Public safety and permit authority remain human.

evidence.claim: Native case-to-document merging can reduce repeated permit preparation without deciding compliance.

assumptions: Conditional E1 workload with actual manual copying; no saving if native merge is already configured. Active-work shares are not measured baselines.
s1 produces the observations and s2 actually writes them; inspection and capture may alternate. s4 uses real application fields and a human determination, not invented compliant data.

Normal compliant path within actual issuance delegation. Failed checks hold issuance; no permit is issued merely because an inspection appointment ended. Other officials' approvals, if required, must be obtained and measured separately before claiming any expanded saving.

s5 is ordinary completed-document verification, not a new self-approval. Its exact version separately gates save and issuance. Changes to conditions, property or recipient invalidate both gates. Native issue audit logging adds no second manual record or runtime saving.
research_questions: Can a native template reproduce actual permit conditions without silently dropping exceptions?

already_counted.description: Inspection, actual evidence entry, human decision, residual preparation, final checks, save and issue remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain permit field mappings and templates when requirements change.

approvals.approved_version: Exact permit package checked in s5
Exact permit, conditions, recipient and issuance authority checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 15 x 40% document preparation reduction = 6 gross points less 1 upkeep. No inspection, judgment, save or issuance saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Investigators retain scene judgments; inspectors retain safety determinations and issuance authority.
role.ambitious_version: A fire inspector or investigator with less repeated lookup and permit copying, while direct observation, evidence collection and public safety decisions remain human.
